en.headline: Civil Service Bureau outlines five-year training plan with AI and patriotic education
en.dek: Secretary for the Civil Service Ingrid Yeung told lawmakers the Continuous Learning Scheme for senior officials will expand to mid-level managers within two years.
body: Secretary for the Civil Service Ingrid Yeung outlined the government’s plans to strengthen civil service training over the next five years at a Legislative Council panel on Monday.

The plans build on work over the past four years and align with Hong Kong’s first five-year plan. They cover improved training management, deeper patriotic education, a citizen-centric service culture, and greater knowledge of national development and global affairs, alongside leadership and innovation technology training.

A Continuous Learning Scheme launched in July requires directorate and senior civil servants to complete annual credits in three priority areas. The bureau expects to extend it to mid-level managers within two years. Departments will be asked to set training requirements and budgets for key grades.

National security content has been incorporated into courses at all levels, and the Civil Service College supports AI training through leadership, general and online programmes to help advance AI-enabled public services.

zh.headline: 公務員事務局闡述五年培訓計劃 加強愛國及人工智能教育
zh.dek: 公務員事務局局長楊何蓓茵向立法會議員表示，持續學習計劃將於兩年內由高級公務員推展至中級管理人員。
body: 公務員事務局局長楊何蓓茵周一在立法會公務員及資助機構員工事務委員會會議上，闡述未來五年加強公務員培訓的計劃。
計劃建基於過去四年的基礎，並配合香港首個五年規劃，涵蓋完善培訓管理、深化愛國主義教育、以民為本服務文化，以及提升對國家發展大局及國際形勢的掌握，同時加強領導及創新科技培訓。
今年七月推出的持續學習計劃要求首長級及高級公務員每年在三個重點範疇修滿學分，預計兩年內推展至中級管理人員。當局亦計劃要求各部門為主要職系訂定培訓要求及預算。
國家安全內容已融入各級課程，公務員學院亦透過領導、通用及網上培訓支援人工智能學習，以推進人工智能賦能的公眾服務。
